title: When Participant Disjoint Validation Is Not Enough to Establish Generalization in Parkinson's Gait Classification
title_zh: 当参与者不相交验证不足以在帕金森步态分类中建立泛化性时
abstract: Participant-disjoint cross-validation prevents direct participant overlap, but it may still produce optimistic estimates when acquisition site and diagnosis are structurally dependent. We examined Parkinson's disease classification using 159 pressure-walkway summary features from 133 WearGait-PD participants, including 65 participants with Parkinson's disease and 68 controls. The cohort was non-factorial: two sites contained only one diagnostic group, whereas VA-Seattle was the only site containing both groups. In repeated participant-level nested cross-validation, site alone achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.955 plus or minus 0.003, exceeding the gait-feature model (0.882 plus or minus 0.014). Under the evaluated logistic-regression pipelines, adding gait features to site, age, and sex produced no measurable improvement in pooled discrimination. More site-controlled evaluations produced lower and imprecise estimates: VA-Seattle same-site AUC was 0.668 (95% bootstrap confidence interval 0.477 to 0.836), and the JHOC + Bayview-to-VA-Seattle transport stress test achieved 0.576 (0.375 to 0.770). Supporting within-diagnosis site-prediction and site-conditioned permutation analyses showed that the gait representation retained substantial acquisition-site structure. These findings indicate that participant-disjoint pooled validation did not isolate disease-related discrimination from site-associated variation. They encourage careful examination of site-label dependence and, where possible, support for pooled results through within-site or independent validation before broader claims are made about generalization across institutions.
abstract_zh: 参与者不相交的交叉验证防止了参与者直接重叠，但当采集站点和诊断在结构上相关时，它仍可能产生乐观的估计。我们使用来自133名WearGait-PD参与者的159个压力步道汇总特征来检验帕金森病分类，其中包括65名帕金森病患者和68名对照。该队列是非析因的：两个站点仅包含一个诊断组，而VA-Seattle是唯一包含两个组的站点。在重复的参与者级嵌套交叉验证中，仅站点就达到了0.955±0.003的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC），超过了步态特征模型（0.882±0.014）。在评估的逻辑回归流程下，将步态特征添加到站点、年龄和性别中，在汇总区分度上没有产生可测量的改善。更多站点控制的评估产生了更低且不精确的估计：VA-Seattle同站点AUC为0.668（95% bootstrap置信区间0.477至0.836），而JHOC + Bayview到VA-Seattle的迁移压力测试达到0.576（0.375至0.770）。支持性的诊断内站点预测和站点条件置换分析表明，步态表示保留了大量的采集站点结构。这些发现表明，参与者不相交的汇总验证未能将疾病相关的区分度与站点相关变异隔离开来。它们鼓励仔细检查站点-标签依赖性，并在可能的情况下，通过站点内或独立验证来支持汇总结果，然后再对跨机构的泛化性做出更广泛的声明。
tldr_zh: 参与者不相交验证仍受站点混杂影响，泛化性被高估。
cover_zh: 你以为参与者不相交就够？站点信息竟比步态特征更准！
